title_en: Hanwha Ocean Fall 2026 New Graduate Recruitment and Campus Information Sessions
summary: Students interested in Hanwha Ocean's second-half 2026 new employee recruitment may attend a lunch or dessert recruitment information session at Seoul National University on Tuesday, September 15. Pre-registration is requested through the QR code or the URL in the notice, but walk-in attendance on the day is also possible. Applications for the recruitment itself must be submitted online through the Hanwha Ocean recruitment website between September 14 and September 30, 2026.
applies_to: Any student interested in Hanwha Ocean's second-half 2026 new employee recruitment. The notice states no restriction by program, year or nationality. Attendance at the information sessions is optional.

dates.what: Application period for Hanwha Ocean second-half 2026 new employee recruitment

conditions: Pre-registration for the information sessions is only to estimate attendance; walk-in attendance on the day is also allowed.
Applications are accepted only online through the Hanwha Ocean recruitment website.
Recruitment fields are design; sales/business management/purchasing; production management; AX; research and development; and management support.
The attached image (한화오션_서울대학교.jpg), including the QR code, was not read; its content may contain additional information.
steps: Information session: Pre-register through the QR code in the attachment or at https://zrr.kr/qZwdtW (optional; walk-in attendance is also possible).
Information session: On Tuesday, September 15, attend the lunch session (12:30–13:40, Building 34, Room 316) or the dessert session (15:00–16:00, Building 301, Room 118).
Application: Read the detailed recruitment information at https://recruit-hanwhaocean.com/ko/2026newrecruits.
Application: Apply online through the Hanwha Ocean recruitment website (recruit-hanwhaocean.com) between September 14 and September 30, 2026.
translation:
[Hanwha Ocean] Promotion of Hanwha Ocean's Second-Half 2026 New Employee Recruitment and Pre-Registration for Recruitment Events

[Pre-registration for Hanwha Ocean's Second-Half 2026 New Employee Recruitment: Seoul National University Lunch & Dessert Recruitment Information Sessions]

■ Date, time and place
Tuesday, September 15
- Lunch recruitment information session | 12:30–13:40, Building 34, Room 316
- Dessert recruitment information session | 15:00–16:00, Building 301, Room 118

■ How to participate
Pre-register through the QR code or the URL below.
*Pre-registration is for the purpose of surveying attendance demand; on-site participation on the day is also possible.
✅ https://zrr.kr/qZwdtW

[Hanwha Ocean Second-Half 2026 New Employee Recruitment]
- Application period: September 14 – September 30, 2026
- How to apply: Online application through the Hanwha Ocean recruitment website (recruit-hanwhaocean.com)
- Recruitment fields: Design; Sales/Business Management/Purchasing; Production Management; AX; Research and Development; Management Support
- Detailed recruitment information: https://recruit-hanwhaocean.com/ko/2026newrecruits
